chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, ruled on the basis of the testimony of one witness and the oath of the claimant.
And he, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Jibril عليه السلام descended upon me with the ruling of the testimony of one witness and the oath of the possessor of the right.”

key_terms.بِالْحُكْمِ: with the legal ruling or judgment
key_terms.بِشَهَادَةِ: by means of testimony as legal evidence
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الْحَقِّ: the one who possesses the right, namely the rightful claimant
key_terms.يَمِينِ: an oath used to support a legal claim

ai.seo_question: Can a legal claim be established by one witness and the claimant’s oath in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes a judicial ruling that a claim may be upheld through the testimony of a single witness together with the oath of the claimant. It also presents this ruling as divinely conveyed through Jibril عليه السلام, underscoring its authority in Islamic legal judgment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3318 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, ruled based on the testimony of one witness and the oath of the claimant.
He (sw), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Jibril (as) descended upon me with the judgment of the testimony of one witness and the oath of the claimant."
